title: workout-completed v2
description: One finished session, signed by the subject's own wallet. It stays off-chain: only its hash enters the monthly Merkle root (see month.sas.json). Nothing identifying and nothing medical — only digests, timestamps, public keys and signal codes. v2 is v1 expressed as a profile of leaf.base.json, with one substantive change: the cosigner role `coach` becomes `notarized`. See spec/profiles.md for why that is a version and not a correction.

window.description: When the session ran, in UTC seconds. end > start, and end - start <= 6 hours.

activity.description: What kind of effort. Coarse on purpose: the detail lives in the payload.

$comment: Every base property is re-listed above because `additionalProperties: false` does not see through `$ref`. See spec/profiles.md.
